+import click
+import pytest
+
+OPAQUE = object()
+
+
+def parse_flag(monkeypatch, activation, env_value, args=(), default_map=None, **settings):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("CLICK_REPEAT_MODE", env_value)
+    option = click.Option(
+        ["--mode"], flag_value=activation, envvar="CLICK_REPEAT_MODE", **settings
+    )
+    command = click.Command("cli", params=[option], add_help_option=False)
+    with command.make_context("cli", list(args), default_map=default_map) as ctx:
+        return ctx.params["mode"], ctx.get_parameter_source("mode")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("activation", ["red blue", 42, OPAQUE])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("env_value", ["1", " true ", "YES", "on"])
+def test_true_environment_is_one_activation(monkeypatch, activation, env_value):
+    value, source = parse_flag(monkeypatch, activation, env_value, multiple=True)
+    assert value == (activation,)
+    assert source is click.ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("activation", ["red blue", "false", "  off  "])
+def test_exact_string_match_is_one_activation(monkeypatch, activation):
+    value, source = parse_flag(monkeypatch, activation, activation, multiple=True)
+    assert value == (activation,)
+    assert source is click.ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("activation", ["red blue", 42, OPAQUE])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("env_value", ["0", " false ", "NO", "off"])
+def test_false_environment_blocks_defaults(monkeypatch, activation, env_value):
+    value, source = parse_flag(
+        monkeypatch, activation, env_value, multiple=True,
+        default=(activation,), default_map={"mode": (activation, activation)}
+    )
+    assert value == ()
+    assert source is click.ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("activation", ["red blue", 42, OPAQUE])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("env_value", ["not-a-bool", "42", ""])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fallback", ["unset", "declared", "map"])
+def test_unrecognized_environment_uses_fallback(monkeypatch, activation, env_value, fallback):
+    settings = {"multiple": True}
+    default_map = None
+    expected = ()
+    expected_source = click.ParameterSource.DEFAULT
+    if fallback == "declared":
+        settings["default"] = (activation,)
+        expected = (activation,)
+    elif fallback == "map":
+        settings["default"] = (activation,)
+        default_map = {"mode": (activation, activation)}
+        expected = (activation, activation)
+        expected_source = click.ParameterSource.DEFAULT_MAP
+    value, source = parse_flag(
+        monkeypatch, activation, env_value, default_map=default_map, **settings
+    )
+    assert value == expected
+    assert source is expected_source
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("activation", ["red blue", 42, OPAQUE])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("env_value", ["true", "false", "not-a-bool"])
+def test_command_line_repetitions_override_environment(monkeypatch, activation, env_value):
+    value, source = parse_flag(
+        monkeypatch, activation, env_value, args=("--mode", "--mode"), multiple=True
+    )
+    assert value == (activation, activation)
+    assert source is click.ParameterSource.COMMANDLINE
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("env_value, expected", [("true", OPAQUE), ("false", False)])
+def test_scalar_non_boolean_flags_remain_scalar(monkeypatch, env_value, expected):
+    value, source = parse_flag(monkeypatch, OPAQUE, env_value)
+    assert value is expected
+    assert source is click.ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("nargs, expected", [(1, ("a", "b", "c", "d")), (2, (("a", "b"), ("c", "d")))])
+def test_ordinary_repeated_values_still_split(monkeypatch, nargs, expected):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("CLICK_REPEAT_VALUES", "a b c d")
+    option = click.Option(
+        ["--item"], multiple=True, nargs=nargs, envvar="CLICK_REPEAT_VALUES"
+    )
+    command = click.Command("cli", params=[option], add_help_option=False)
+    with command.make_context("cli", []) as ctx:
+        assert ctx.params["item"] == expected
+        assert ctx.get_parameter_source("item") is click.ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT
